summary:
Graviton support for PyTorch and TensorFlow inference is implemented in the generated repo, and nothing is committed. Both spec examples return the expected URIs (pytorch-inference-graviton:1.12.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker and tensorflow-inference-graviton:2.9.1-cpu-py38-ubuntu20.04-sagemaker).

Changes:
- src/sagemaker/image_uris.py: Graviton instance-family detection. For PyTorch/TensorFlow inference on Graviton families (no EIA accelerator), retrieve() uses a new "<framework>-graviton" config.
- src/sagemaker/image_uri_config/pytorch-graviton.json and tensorflow-graviton.json: new inference configs (single version each, ubuntu20.04-sagemaker CPU container version).
- tests/unit/sagemaker/image_uris/test_dlc_frameworks.py: four new tests (both spec URIs, no-version default, non-Graviton unaffected).

Verification: image_uris, pytorch, fw_utils, tensorflow and jumpstart suites pass against the generated src/ (1031 and 1776 passed, 482 skipped, 0 failures). The shared venv lacks mock and yaml; I used a throwaway mock shim in /tmp outside the repo and venv. An earlier run imported the base SDK by mistake; the reported results come from the corrected PYTHONPATH=src run.

Open items: Graviton registry 763104351884 is applied to all commercial regions from the PyTorch list without network verification; please confirm before merging. CHANGELOG, docs and merge-checklist items were not updated.
